# Assembly clash and clearance report (generated by `python -m cad.audit`; do not edit)

45 parts, 990 part pairs. 191 poses: zero pose, 25 poses across each joint's full spec range (others at zero), and 40 random poses with all joints in range. Zero pose: exact B-rep booleans and distances for every pair. Swept/random poses: every pair screened with FCL on fine meshes (0.02 mm chord, 3 deg), and every pair the meshes report touching re-checked with an exact B-rep boolean. Gear teeth and fasteners included; overlap threshold 0.001 mm3. Run time 483 s.

**Result: PASS** (0 failures)


## Overlaps

None at any pose.

## Declared running contacts

- servo_yaw_case / servo_yaw_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- servo_shoulder_case / servo_shoulder_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- servo_elbow_case / servo_elbow_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- servo_wrist_pitch_case / servo_wrist_pitch_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- servo_roll_case / servo_roll_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- servo_gripper_case / servo_gripper_horn: servo output: horn hub seats on the servo's own output
- shoulder_bracket / yaw_bearing: 61816 inner race on the turntable spigot (bearing interface)
- idler_bearing_shoulder / upper_arm: 6701 outer race pressed into the child idler plate
- forearm / idler_bearing_elbow: 6701 outer race pressed into the child idler plate
- idler_bearing_wrist / wrist_bracket: 6701 outer race pressed into the child idler plate
- jaw_a / pinion: involute rack-and-pinion mesh, 0.1 mm backlash per flank by design
- jaw_b / pinion: involute rack-and-pinion mesh, 0.1 mm backlash per flank by design
- pad_a / pad_b: gripper fully closed: pad faces meet (that is the closed position)
- jaw_a / jaw_b: jaws slide past each other in separate y-layers
